name: hunyuan_video_worker
summary: Connects chain_event_render's dormant video path to actual MP4 output. Tails ~/.cc/chain_renders/_video_queue.jsonl, submits a HunyuanVideo T2V workflow per job to ComfyUI on :8188, polls /history/<prompt_id> every 5s, downloads the MP4 via /view, saves to <render_dir>/video.mp4, and patches the render's manifest.json. Single-instance via lockfile so concurrent workers don't fight the GPU. Each job is one-at-a-time — HunyuanVideo-1.5 needs ~22-24 GB VRAM at 720p bf16 on a 3090 Ti.
engine_pattern: Stdlib urllib + ComfyUIMCPConnector. Per-job: probe /system_stats → POST /prompt → poll /history/{id} until status_str ∈ {success, error} or timeout → GET /view?filename=&subfolder=&type= → stream-write to dest. Offset file tracks queue progress; lockfile guards single-instance. comfy_offline status deliberately does NOT advance offset — the job stays pending and retries when comfy is back up. All other terminal statuses (rendered / submit_error / exec_error / timeout) DO advance.

medialab_path.model_card_status_2026_05_28: MediaLab/CLAUDE.md states 'All video/audio models: not yet downloaded' — when weights are missing the worker will surface ComfyUI's load error and stop on that job (status='exec_error', queue advances). Run MediaLab/scripts/download_models.sh first.

cli: run [--once] [--max-jobs N] [--width W --height H --length F --steps N --fps N] [--timeout S]
status                                       — queue + offset + lock + completed counts
seed <event.json>                            — enqueue a job from a chain event
reset-lock                                   — remove stale lock after crash
workflow-preview                             — print the default workflow JSON

operational_notes.gpu_pinning: Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 in MediaLab's ComfyUI launcher (per /data/Projects/CLAUDE.md, GPU 1 preferred for inference). Worker doesn't manage GPU pinning — it just submits.
operational_notes.throughput: ~10-25 min per 3s clip @ 720×1280 / 30 steps on a single 3090 Ti. Use --steps 12 for 1.5x faster preview-quality renders.
operational_notes.tuning: --length controls duration (frames). 73 = ~3s @ 24fps. Hunyuan-1.5 supports up to 129 frames per generation; beyond that needs chunking.
operational_notes.missing_models: If you see status='exec_error' with 'UNETLoader' or 'VAELoader' in error → models not in ComfyUI/models/. Run MediaLab/scripts/download_models.sh and ensure files land in the right subdir or set MSPC_HUNYUAN_* env vars.
operational_notes.concurrency_safety: Lockfile holds os.getpid(); stale locks are detected by signal probe (os.kill(pid, 0)). cc hunyuan-reset-lock can force clear if needed.

five_canonical_frames_per_video_event.fps: frame_pack across all 5 canonical FPS — same as image side
